item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's father is setting up a shaving mirror at home that must give an enlarged image of the face, and her school is making a solar cooker that must concentrate sunlight at one point. Which optical element should be used for both purposes?

options.A: a plane mirror, because it always shows things clearly
options.B: a convex mirror, because it gives a wide view
options.C: a concave mirror, because it can form an enlarged image and also converge light to a focus
options.D: a convex lens, because it can form an enlarged image but cannot be used in a solar cooker
